name: agent-office-checks
description: Development checks for the dependency-free Agent Office frontend

scripts.test: node --test tests/opencode-bridge.test.mjs tests/vscode-panel.test.cjs tests/scene-model.test.cjs tests/jukebox-model.test.cjs tests/personalization.test.cjs tests/pets.test.cjs tests/arcade-model.test.cjs tests/arcade-host.test.cjs tests/aquarium-care.test.cjs tests/studio-model.test.cjs tests/studio-directional-model.test.cjs tests/studio-tools-model.test.cjs tests/preview-read-lock.test.cjs tests/studio-environment-model.test.cjs tests/attention.test.cjs tests/studio-pet-life-model.test.cjs tests/prompt-library-model.test.cjs tests/studio-character-life-model.test.cjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:original && npm run test:browser:studio
scripts.format: prettier --write "web/**/*.{js,css,html}" "site/*.{js,css,html}" "vscode/*.{js,json}" "tests/*.{cjs,mjs}" package.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" tools/build_site.mjs tools/build_sprites.mjs tools/build_studio_directional.mjs tools/build_studio_environment.mjs tools/build_preview.mjs tools/build_paths.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "web/**/*.{js,css,html}" "site/*.{js,css,html}" "vscode/*.{js,json}" "tests/*.{cjs,mjs}" package.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" tools/build_site.mjs tools/build_sprites.mjs tools/build_studio_directional.mjs tools/build_studio_environment.mjs tools/build_preview.mjs tools/build_paths.mjs
